verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI is a code-first Python agent framework, not a product with a distinct UI layered over an API — its only interactive surface (the `clai` CLI) is itself built directly on top of the same Agent API (`Agent.to_cli_sync()`), so there is no separate 'UI' whose capabilities could outpace the API. The UI-vs-API parity question is a category error for this kind of library/framework product.
